name: Ashleigh Graveline
bio: Clinical Associate Professor of Occupational Therapy and Academic Fieldwork Coordinator at Clarkson. A North Country clinician her whole career — St. Lawrence Psychiatric Center in Ogdensburg, Claxton-Hepburn Medical Center, Salmon River Central School, and United Helpers — she specializes in psychiatric rehabilitation and holds a Certified Psychiatric Rehabilitation Practitioner credential (2023). She chairs Clarkson's Interprofessional Education Committee and serves as Vice Chair of the Faculty Senate.
